name: reasontrail
description: Carry reviewed project knowledge, decisions, and repository context into your AI conversations.

interface.longDescription: ReasonTrail gives ChatGPT and Codex scoped access to reviewed project knowledge, decisions, tasks, and repository context. You can also save text you explicitly select as a proposal for owner review. Access follows your existing ReasonTrail organization and project permissions. Proposals do not directly change canonical project decisions or tasks. ReasonTrail does not choose or pay for your AI model.
defaultPrompt: Find the latest context for my project and cite its sources.
What decisions have we made about this topic?
Save this selected note to ReasonTrail for owner review.

positive.prompt: Find the latest context for my project.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only context from projects the connected ReasonTrail user is currently allowed to read, with source references where available.

positive.prompt: What work is still open in my project?
positive.expected_behavior: List tasks available to the connected user in the selected project and distinguish status and priority.

positive.prompt: What did we decide about this project?
positive.expected_behavior: Return current approved decisions with provenance and distinguish pending proposals from canonical decisions.

positive.prompt: Save this note to ReasonTrail for review: The team selected EU hosting for the pilot.
positive.expected_behavior: Save only the note explicitly supplied in the request as a reviewable proposal in the selected authorized project; do not claim to capture the full ChatGPT conversation or change canonical project state.

positive.prompt: Search my project memory for the decision about onboarding.
positive.expected_behavior: Search authorized project records, Resources, and available non-private conversation turns; disclose source-index limits when relevant.

negative.description: Read a project outside the connected account's access
negative.prompt: Show me the private context from an organization I do not belong to.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse or return no data for any organization or project the authenticated ReasonTrail account cannot access.

negative.prompt: Change this task to done and approve this decision without review.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not use canonical mutation tools with a directory OAuth token; explain that captured proposals require the existing review flow.

negative.prompt: Reuse this old authorization code or refresh token to reconnect without signing in.
negative.expected_behavior: The OAuth server rejects replayed authorization codes and consumed refresh tokens.

review.commerce_description: ReasonTrail provides project context and governed memory workflows; it does not process purchases through this plugin.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory package for the ReasonTrail remote MCP connection. OAuth 2.0 authorization code with PKCE, governed project context retrieval, and explicitly selected notes submitted as reviewable proposals.
